mechanism: Atorvastatin is metabolized by CYP3A4, and eplerenone is a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor, increasing atorvastatin concentrations and myopathy risk; both drugs also increase potassium levels when combined.
action: Monitor potassium levels and renal function regularly; consider alternative statin (pravastatin or rosuvastatin) or reduce atorvastatin dose; counsel on muscle pain symptoms.
